selection.type: purposive source-first supplement; not random, blind, or representative
selection.basis: Saved source text inspection found diagnostic comparisons outside the materialized-unit tags. Five papers selected for usable source material; unit boundaries fixed here before visual grading/query formulation or any retrieval capture. Totton species keys are not the prior reviewed genus keys. Four Vanhoeffen units are the first four numbered species treatments, in source order.
selection.prior_inspection: Agent read saved Docling text for several candidate passages and saw headings. Prior source reviews/fixes included other Totton pages. No retrieval ranks/results have been inspected for these units.
selection.no_replacement: Every frozen candidate is retained with its final status. Unscorable/duplicate candidates are not replaced to fill a quota. Different questions about one treatment do not make extra units.
selection.excluded: Fixed audit/control target pages; original five frozen materialized-sample source units/pages; references, contents, incidental mentions, and numeric measurement tables without diagnostic structure.

review_rules.eligible: One source taxonomic treatment, diagnostic comparison, or identification key with explicit distinguishing morphology; a taxon mention/heading alone is insufficient. Historical concepts are assessed as stated by their original author, not asserted to be current taxonomy.
review_rules.visual_verification: Read original PDF page renders; preserve source hash, physical page, exact source region, crop hash, and reviewer record. Saved OCR is a locator and possible machine anchor, never source truth.
review_rules.queries: One natural unassisted corpus-wide query per eligible unit, with source-faithful historical attribution where needed; no paper filter, source quote stuffing, or rank-guided wording.
review_rules.targets: Grade2 answer-bearing diagnostic content, grade1 contextual content, grade0 source-reviewed irrelevant content. Distinctive all_text anchors; missing/unmatched content remains unjudged, not irrelevant. Preserve uncertainty/qualifications in source notes.
review_rules.freeze: Freeze final source-reviewed manifest and its SHA256 before capture/ranking. No later label changes without new manifest identity and recapture of both workflows.

acceptance.improvement: Follow existing evaluator: improved independent hit rate at one depth without decrease at other depth or controls; all existing exact audit/control queries retained.
acceptance.population_limit: This selected supplement addresses held-out diagnostic comparisons, not prevalence/recall across the deployment. It does not retroactively repair the insufficient original materialized-unit sample.
acceptance.retrieval_population: Full intended reference and candidate corpora with all fixed and sampled papers. Gold-only captures are pilot evidence, not deployment acceptance.
